comments.value: Why isn't this already a thing
Since this one seems to be gaining more traction, feel free to merge in my duplicate https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/group-invite-instances-not-to-be-confused-with-group
This feature would really help for groups to grow organically
I mean yea, I am all about Group+
This sounds like a good idea ^^

details: Invite plus is a really cool feature that allows people a chance to screen their friends and make sure they would fit in an instance. It would be really useful to have this as a group feature! This could be really good for smaller more close-knit groups to still allow new people to join without making an instance open for *anyone* to join or forcing people to join a group they haven’t met.
title: Group: invite +
